title: Chicken and Onion Soup
steps: Cook chicken in olive oil until cooked.
Add chopped onion to the pot with chicken.
Add water and bring to a boil.
Stir in garlic and cook for another minute.
Reduce heat and simmer for about 20 minutes or until chicken is tender.
Serve hot with extra vegetables like carrots or potatoes
comment: Ingredientes 'explotados' caracter a caracter; pasos coherentes.

title: Simple Egg and Carrot Fried Rice
steps: Prepare rice according to package instructions.
Toast the carrot until it's very soft.
Mix the cooked rice with salt, pepper, olive oil, water, and garlic.
Place the egg mixture in a shallow dish or bowl.

title: Beef and Potato Stir-Fry
steps: In a large skillet, heat olive oil over medium-high heat.
Add the beef, stirring occasionally to prevent it from browning.
Cook for about 5 minutes or until browned.
Remove the beef from the skillet and set aside.
Stir in the garlic, cooking for about 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add the potatoes to the skillet with the beef and cook until they are soft and slightly tender (about 10-15 minutes)
Stir in water, salt, and pepper. Cook for another 2-3 minutes or until the vegetables are well coated.
comment: Limpia y coherente; la mejor del modelo pequeno.

title: Simple Poblano Chicken Pasta
comment: Fallo total: pasos e ingredientes explotados en caracteres sueltos.

title: Tomato Sauce with Chiken
steps: Prepare the tomatoe by peeling and cutting into small pieces.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add chopped garlic to the oil and sauté for about 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add chiken to the skillet with tomatoe and sauté until golden brown.
Stir in water, salt, and pepper. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and let simmer for 5-7 minutes.
comment: Ingredientes explotados; mantiene los typos; ajo no listado.

title: Garbanzo Bean and Tomato Soup
steps: Prepare the onions and garlic in batches.
Boil the vegetables and mince the garlic.
Sauté the onions with garlic and olive oil.
Add the garbanzo beans to the pot along with water and vegetable broth.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes.
Season with salt and black pepper.
